notes: Company summary: Pelagia processes sensor logs, vessel reports, and regulatory docs for maritime customers. Using search + RAG to power analyst workflows and automated reporting.
Primary pain: current Elastic cluster struggles at 40M indexed docs with hybrid queries (BM25 + vector); tail latency spikes during business hours.
Workload targets: initial index ~100M documents (text+metadata), steady-state ingest 10M docs/day during ramp, sustained query load 200 qps with peaks to 600 qps.
Latency SLOs: vector recall + top-50 rerank end-to-end P95 < 300ms, P95 vector ANN step < 150ms. Interactive UI requires P99 < 600ms for median workflows.
Cost target: average cost-per-query (embeddings+ANN+rerank) < $0.01, acknowledging peak windows can be higher; looking for batch/slotting suggestions.
Embedding profile: in-house 1536-d embeddings (will want to reuse proprietary model). Must support custom embedding vector shape and upsert/refresh cadence.
Reranking approach: two-stage: ANN candidate recall -> cross-encoder rerank. Cross-encoder may run on CPU with quantized model or on small GPU; expected rerank latency budget ~100-180ms.

Vector DB connector requirements: incremental bulk upserts, streaming upsert API, per-document metadata filtering, hybrid search (BM25 + vector), choose ANN algorithms (HNSW, IVF+PQ), snapshot/backup support, region residency controls, ability to expose metrics (latency, recall), and graceful fallback to smaller model variants.

DB preferences: evaluating pgvector (cost & control), Pinecone (managed ops), Weaviate (hybrid graph & ML hooks), Elastic (existing infra + kNN plugin). Need benchmarks from Redwood comparing these connectors at 100M scale.
Indexing constraints: acceptable indexing throughput 20k docs/min for PoC; support for delta updates and fast deletes. Need cold/hot tier strategy: recent docs kept in memory for low latency.
Security/compliance: EU data residency mandatory for subset of PII fields; SSO/SAML required; full audit logs for query/ingest operations; KMS integration for key management.
Quote from head of infra: "We cannot accept black-box embeddings routing; must see how vectors are stored, encryption-in-flight/rest, and snapshot controls."

Operational asks: automated schema migration for vector dims, tooling for measuring recall/regression against golden prompt sets, cost breakdown per token and per-vector-search, tracing hooks for per-request latency attribution.
PoC goals: ingest 100M documents into chosen connector, run 1000 QA prompts (eval set) to measure recall and E2E latency, demonstrate rerank stack and cost per 1k queries.
Decision factors: performance at scale, ops burden (managed vs self-host), connector maturity (metadata filters + hybrid queries), cost per q, compliance capabilities.
Next meeting: 2026-03-20 PoC kickoff window in staging VPC; InfoSec to finish questionnaire by 2026-03-18.
